title: Cosmic Multiverse Guardian
description: A large purple humanoid figure with multiple eyes and faces stands in the foreground, holding a miniature ringed planet with tiny white figures walking on it. The surreal black background features red mountains, geometric constellations, a white insectoid traveler with a backpack on a pyramid, and various esoteric symbols.
prompt: Surreal black background scene with red mountain range. Foreground shows a tall purple humanoid with multiple eyes on its head and face, white floral patterns on skin, sharp teeth, holding a small red ringed planet with tiny white human figures walking across it. To the right, a white insect-like humanoid with red eye and backpack stands atop geometric pyramids. Scattered esoteric symbols, constellations, floating eyes, and geometric shapes fill the dark space. Mystical and cosmic atmosphere.
